subject: Trouble with Deducer running on MacOS Sierra

messages.author: 92003cec993bb0dd
messages.subject: Trouble with Deducer running on MacOS Sierra
parts:
I installed R 3.3.2. I installed Deducer by entering:
install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer","DeducerExtras"))

No problem there. But to run deducer I enter:

> Sys.setenv(NOAWT=1)
> library(JGR)

And this happens:

Loading required package: rJava
Loading required package: JavaGD
Loading required package: iplots
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'iplots', details:
  call: .jinit()
  error: JNI_GetCreatedJavaVMs returned -1

Error: package ‘iplots’ could not be loaded
JavaVM: requested Java version ((null)) not available. Using Java at "" instead.
JavaVM: Failed to load JVM: /bundle/Libraries/libserver.dylib
JavaVM FATAL: Failed to load the jvm library.

Can someone help me solve this problem to run Deducer?
Thank you very much.

messages.author: 30dc0c001c553eb0
messages.subject: Re: Trouble with Deducer running on MacOS Sierra
parts:
Firstly, Deducer runs just fine on MacOs Sierra.
The problem is most likely with rJava, which both JGR and Deducer depend on. I was struggling with that one myself before I finally got it to work.
rJava can be quite tricky to get working depending on which java version you are using on the Mac (apple legacy or latest oracle idk). rJava also must be updated to the latest release to be compatible.
There has been some discussion and tips in various forums, e.g. https://github.com/s-u/rJava/issues/86
Good luck.
